title: Integrative Machine Learning and Experimental Validation Identify MYBL2 as a Prognostic Biomarker and Therapeutic Target in Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
authors: Yang, Ya-Ling; Huang, Ying-Hsien; Lin, Hung-Yu
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习筛选肝癌预后标志物MYBL2并验证miR-29a调控，虽涉及转录因子但无蛋白-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) presents with poor treatment outcomes, creating an urgent need for novel biomarkers to improve diagnosis, prognosis, and precision medicine. While the MYB family of oncogenes is implicated in cancer, the role and regulatory mechanisms of its member, particularly MYB proto-oncogene like 2 (MYBL2), remain underexplored in HCC. Therefore, this study aimed to systematically validate the clinical significance of MYBL2, elucidate its functional role in tumor progression and drug sensitivity, and identify its upstream regulatory mechanisms using an integrative machine learning and experimental framework. METHODS: We applied an integrative pipeline combining LASSO-based feature selection on TCGA and GEO cohorts, single-cell transcriptomics, pharmacogenomic surveys, and CRISPR dependency screens. These computational approaches were complemented by in vitro HepG2 assays, luciferase reporter tests, iTRAQ proteomics, and an in vivo western diet/CCl(4) (WD/CCl(4)) HCC model using miR-29a transgenic mice to investigate a putative regulatory axis. RESULTS: MYBL2 robustly discriminated tumor from normal liver (AUC = 0.968), and high expression was associated with adverse features, including higher grade, microvascular invasion, HBV positivity, nonresponse to TACE, and worse survival. A nomogram combining MYBL2 with AJCC stage improved 1-, 3-, and 5-year AUCs versus stage alone. MYBL2 correlated with proliferative biomarkers (AFP, MKI67, PCNA, BIRC5) and CRISPR knockout inhibited growth in most HCC lines. High MYBL2 expression was associated with greater sensitivity to sorafenib in pharmacogenomic screens and was linked to an immunosuppressive microenvironment and higher MSI. Mechanistically, miR-29a was shown to suppress MYBL2 translation by directly binding to its 3(')-UTR; this was validated in vivo, where miR-29a transgenic mice were protected from WD/CCl(4)-induced HCC, demonstrating reduced tumor burden, MYBL2 expression, and fibrosis. iTRAQ proteomics further confirmed MYBL2 as a top miR-29a-regulated protein. CONCLUSIONS: MYBL2 is a potent diagnostic and prognostic biomarker in HCC that also predicts sorafenib sensitivity. Our findings establish a clear regulatory link where MYBL2 is a direct and functionally important target of the tumor-suppressive miR-29a. This positions MYBL2 as a tractable target for miR-29a-based therapeutic strategies, warranting clinical validation for patient stratification and treatment development in HCC.
abstract_zh: 背景：肝细胞癌（HCC）的治疗效果不佳，迫切需要新型生物标志物以改善诊断、预后和精准医学。尽管MYB癌基因家族与癌症相关，但其成员，特别是MYB原癌基因样2（MYBL2），在HCC中的作用及调控机制仍未充分探索。因此，本研究旨在系统验证MYBL2的临床意义，阐明其在肿瘤进展和药物敏感性中的功能作用，并通过整合机器学习和实验框架识别其上游调控机制。方法：我们应用了一个整合流程，结合基于TCGA和GEO队列的LASSO特征选择、单细胞转录组学、药物基因组学调查和CRISPR依赖性筛选。这些计算方法辅以体外HepG2实验、荧光素酶报告基因测试、iTRAQ蛋白质组学，以及使用miR-29a转基因小鼠的体内西方饮食/CCl(4)（WD/CCl(4)）HCC模型，以研究一个假定的调控轴。结果：MYBL2稳健地区分肿瘤与正常肝脏（AUC = 0.968），高表达与不良特征相关，包括更高分级、微血管侵犯、HBV阳性、对TACE无反应和更差生存。将MYBL2与AJCC分期结合的列线图，在1年、3年和5年AUC上优于单独分期。MYBL2与增殖生物标志物（AFP、MKI67、PCNA、BIRC5）相关，CRISPR敲除在大多数HCC细胞系中抑制生长。高MYBL2表达与药物基因组学筛选中对索拉非尼的更高敏感性相关，并与免疫抑制微环境和更高MSI相关。机制上，miR-29a通过直接结合其3(')-UTR抑制MYBL2翻译；这在体内得到验证，miR-29a转基因小鼠免受WD/CCl(4)诱导的HCC，表现出肿瘤负担、MYBL2表达和纤维化减少。iTRAQ蛋白质组学进一步确认MYBL2为miR-29a调控的主要蛋白之一。结论：MYBL2是HCC中有效的诊断和预后生物标志物，也预测索拉非尼敏感性。我们的发现建立了明确的调控联系，即MYBL2是肿瘤抑制性miR-29a的直接且功能重要的靶点。这将MYBL2定位为基于miR-29a治疗策略的可操作靶点，值得临床验证以用于HCC中的患者分层和治疗开发。
